output.summary: The change replaces userRoles.includes(role) with a Set-based lookup in hasRequiredRoles. Behavior is preserved: Set.has uses SameValueZero equality, which for strings is identical to the case-sensitive exact string equality that Array.prototype.includes uses; requiredRoles.every returns true for an empty requirements array, preserving the empty-permits-access rule; and deduplication via the Set does not alter authorization semantics. No correctness, security, concurrency, reliability, or regression issues were identified.
